## Qing Chang {.about-name}

Research data scientist and computational social scientist

::: {.about-affiliations}
Hub for AI and Data Science Leadership (HAIL), University of Pittsburgh

Affiliate: [Responsible Data Science, Complexity, and AI for Peace Lab](https://michaelcolaresi.com/redscaip) &middot; [Resilient Economy Lab](https://sites.pitt.edu/~mrfrank/resilientEconomy.html)
:::

I use AI, data, and rigorous social science methods to generate credible evidence on industrial policy, technological innovation, talent flows, and conflict.

## Academic Background

I received my Ph.D. in Political Science from the University of Pittsburgh, with fields in Comparative Politics and Political Methodology.

Before coming to Pittsburgh, I earned an M.S. in Political Science from Duke University and an M.S. in Economics from North Carolina State University.
